lucee.notes:
When used with strings, since Lucee 6, this function iterates over each character in the string.

For list-based iteration with delimiters, use [[function-listeach]] instead.

[LDEV-3747](https://luceeserver.atlassian.net/browse/LDEV-3747)

name: each
description: call the given UDF/Closure with every entry (key/value) in the given collection.
syntax: each( object collection, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
UDF/Closure that call with the entries from the collection

`function (value, idx, coll){}`

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
